dissented.claim_defeated: the crosswalk is honest about T3, and no entry can get a false standing past the checker
dissented.finding: A false standing passes cleanly through the READING and NONE doors. On the live entry sov_operating_agent_status, whose value is OWNER_ACCEPTED_CONTEXT_PROFILE_BUILT_SELF_TESTED_NOT_WITNESSED, setting artifact_standing to WITNESSED with standing_source READING gives exit 0 and the message that 48 are typed against 40 subjects with no defects. The same entry with artifact_standing RATIFIED and standing_source NONE also passes. The reason is that the token check inspects only entries declaring TOKEN, and LEADING_TOKEN_UNTYPED fires only when a ladder word is the first token of the value, which it is not here.
dissented.consequence: The contract states that LEADING_TOKEN_UNTYPED closes the escape of declaring READING to dodge the token check. It closes it only for values beginning with a ladder word, and 33 of the 48 live entries do not begin with one, so for those the READING door is open. A crosswalk entry can assert WITNESSED about a subject whose own status line says NOT_WITNESSED, and the check that exists to type standing honestly reports no defect. standing_source NONE is worse than READING, because the vocabulary of the contract defines NONE as the value asserting no ladder position, so an entry declaring NONE together with a non-null artifact_standing is internally contradictory and still unrefused. No live entry currently uses READING, zero of 48, and no live entry has a non-null standing with a non-TOKEN source, so the hazard is unexploited today. The open door, not the current data, is the finding.
dissented.what_would_have_defeated_this_finding: a refusal firing when a non-TOKEN source declares a standing that the value negates with NOT anywhere, or that the value contradicts with a different ladder token, plus an unconditional refusal for standing_source NONE carrying a non-null artifact_standing.

dissented.claim_defeated: CLAIM_KIND_COLLISION enforces that the eight duplicated keys resolve to one subject holding two kinds
dissented.finding: The collision check grades a hand-authored declaration where it could have measured. The subject field is free text in the crosswalk and nothing binds it to the field name. Renaming the subject of one byom entry from byom to byom-ruling dissolves the collision: exit 0, no defects. The same escape works through claim_kind, which is never validated against the claim_kinds vocabulary of the contract, so an invented kind or the typo RULLING splits the group and passes with exit 0. Measured independently: for all 48 live entries the subject equals the field with the status suffix removed and underscores replaced by hyphens, with zero exceptions, so the value is fully derivable from bytes the check already reads.
dissented.consequence: This is the defect class the witnessing procedure names directly, a check that reads a declaration where it could have measured. The one-subject-two-kinds property that SCT-5 confirms is upheld by the hand of the builder rather than by the check that appears to enforce it, and the check would not notice a one-word edit breaking it. Because a mistyped claim_kind also silently disables RULING_TYPED_AS_ACCEPTANCE, which compares kind strings literally, one unvalidated field defeats two refusals at once.
dissented.what_would_have_defeated_this_finding: deriving the subject from the field inside the checker and refusing any entry whose declared subject disagrees; or at minimum refusing any claim_kind outside the declared claim_kinds and any standing_source outside the declared standing_sources.

residuals.finding: The committed contract points at a decision record that does not exist in the commit. contracts/status-claims.json sets its decision field to decisions/0074-typed-standing-and-the-node-graph.md and lists the same path in governed_by; git cat-file -e reports that the path does not exist in 5dbe513. The other three governed_by entries resolve. Nothing under scripts/ grades governed_by or decision references, so this passes silently and no verify check moved. The artifact declares itself PROPOSED under a governing document the repository does not contain.

RULING_TYPED_AS_ACCEPTANCE is a two-way check between a RULED value and an OWNER_ACCEPTED_A-digit value only, so mistyping either as STATUS is unrefused. Demonstrated: changing only claim_kind on specification_status from OWNER_ACCEPTANCE to STATUS, subject untouched, gives exit 0 and no defect. The contract gives OWNER_ACCEPTANCE reversible false and settled_by seat:root, and STATUS reversible true and settled_by null, so this silently demotes an irreversible owner acceptance to a reversible general status, which is the conflation the contract exists to prevent.

The reader silently defines its own scope. The field regex is anchored at column zero and requires a value with no spaces, so an indented status field, or a column-zero one whose value contains spaces, is invisible and earns no FIELD_UNTYPED; both perturbations gave exit 0. Measured: STATUS.yaml currently carries zero lines of either shape, so this is unexploited, but a future hand edit in either shape would be untyped rather than refused, and the file is hand-written by the account of the contract itself.

Matching is set-based in both directions, so cardinality is unchecked. Duplicating a crosswalk entry under a second subject passes with exit 0 and inflates the report to 49 typed against 41 subjects. One STATUS.yaml line can be typed as being about two different subjects with no refusal.

A malformed crosswalk entry crashes rather than refuses. Removing artifact_standing from an entry raises KeyError, and setting subject to null raises TypeError inside sorted. Both exit non-zero so the gate still fails closed, but the operator sees a traceback rather than a named refusal, and no schema validates entry shape. contracts/schemas/ does not exist in this repository, so no local convention is broken; the AGENTS.md requirement of JSON Schema Draft 2020-12 at machine boundaries is the standing rule this sits against.

No unit test module accompanies the new script. scripts/tests/ holds 65 test modules and none covers sov_status_claims.py; both verify runs report 273 tests run, identically. token_asserts, the function carrying the T3 handling, has no direct unit test and is exercised by exactly one selfcheck case. Step 4 of the AGENTS.md implementation order asks for focused unit tests for local mechanics and edge cases alongside the contract case.

selfcheck accepts a case that fires extra refusals. The comparison asks only whether the expected code is among those earned, so a defeating case passes while possibly firing for a reason other than the one it names. Only the positive case requires an empty set.

conformance/fixtures/status-claims/cases.json is named in neither conformance/scenarios.json nor conformance/oracle-controls.json, and is read only by scripts/sov_status_claims.py. Four of the nine existing fixture directories, ai-native, board, closure and tickets, are equally unregistered, so this follows local practice rather than departing from it. Recorded so it is not mistaken for oracle coverage: the seven refusals are proved by a tool under scripts/ reading a fixture, not by the conformance oracle.

The artifact exists, runs, is wired to the bytes it grades, reads STATUS.yaml line by line rather than through a YAML parser that would collapse the very duplicates it types, and all seven declared refusals fire under perturbations built by the witness rather than by the builder. It does not support BUILT to WITNESSED as a complete result. SCT-D2 shows the collision refusal grading a hand-authored subject that is mechanically derivable from data the check already holds. SCT-D3 shows the commit adding a failing claim to the orientation snapshot that is invisible from the worktree of the builder. The seven refusals are sound, and they are not the right seven.

judgement_items.question: This change cannot be landed consistently by the grant that would land it: registering two checks moves the count to 42, correcting CLAUDE.md line 105 is required for the orientation snapshot of the repository to be truthful about the artifact, and CLAUDE.md is excluded from grant:standing-landing-loop as a root governing document. Should the landing grant widen to cover a mechanical count on the orientation page, should the verification-checks claim of the snapshot read HEAD rather than the working tree, or should any check-registering change route to Bdo by construction?
